title: Wrap-up and thanks
summary: Closing remarks and thanks between DiBlasio and Monk Rowe.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: You know what I mean? This guy’s in another thing. But it was — I don’t even remember what you asked me.
Whatever it was, it was a good answer. So I enjoyed this a lot.
Oh well thank you, Monk. I mean — make me look thin, would you? Can you help me out?
We’ll see if we have some magic on that. Okay?

Well I hope it came off okay. I appreciate it thanks, man. This was great. And thanks for doing what you’re doing because like I said before, these interviews you’re doing are great and it’s going to be worth more as time goes on you know. And already you have some priceless things in there.
All right. Thanks for adding to them.
